Title: Azure Database for MySQL is now available in France South

Body.Content:
To provide a best-in-class managed open-source database offering,  Azure Database for MySQL is now generally available in the France South region. Take advantage of additional flexibility in deploying solutions that help accelerate innovation with fully managed, enterprise-ready community MySQL database as a service.

For current information about the regional availability of Azure Database for MySQL, see Products available by region.
